(a) the length of \(AD\),

(b) the total surface area of the prism \(ABCDEFGH\).
(5 marks)
original.stemZh:
9. 圖 2 中，實心直立棱柱 \(ABCDEFGH\) 的體積為 \(1020\text{ cm}^3\)。棱柱的底面 \(ABCD\) 為梯形，其中 \(AD\parallel BC\)。已知 \(\angle BAD=90^\circ\)、\(AB=12\) cm、\(BC=6\) cm 及 \(DE=10\) cm。

(a) \(AD\) 的長度；

(b) 棱柱 \(ABCDEFGH\) 的總表面積。
（5 分）
original.hint: Known prism volume → find the base area first.
original.hintZh: 直立棱柱＋已知體積 → 先反求底面積。
original.solution: (a) A right prism has volume equal to base area times its length. Thus the trapezoidal base area is \(1020/10=102\text{ cm}^2\). Its parallel sides are \(BC\) and \(AD\), separated by \(AB=12\) cm. \[\frac12(6+AD)(12)=102 \Rightarrow AD=11\text{ cm}.\] (b) The horizontal and vertical components of \(CD\) are \(11-6=5\) cm and \(12\) cm. Hence \[CD=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13\text{ cm}.\] The total surface area comprises two trapezoidal ends and four rectangular sides: \[S=2(102)+(12+6+13+11)(10)=624\text{ cm}^2.\] Check: \(102\times10=1020\text{ cm}^3\), as given.

（a）直立棱柱體積 = 底面積 × 長度。梯形底面積 = 1020/10 = 102 cm²。平行邊為 BC 及 AD，距離 AB = 12 cm：
\[
\frac12(6+AD)(12)=102 \Rightarrow AD=11\text{ cm}.
\]
（b）CD 的水平及垂直分量分別為 11−6 = 5 cm 及 12 cm：
\[
CD=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13\text{ cm}.
\]
總表面積包括兩個梯形端面及四個長方形側面：
\[
S=2(102)+(12+6+13+11)(10)=624\text{ cm}^2.
\]

12. Figure 3(a) shows a solid metal right circular cone of base radius \(48\) cm and height \(96\) cm.

(a) Find the volume of the circular cone in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A hemispherical vessel of radius \(60\) cm is held vertically on a horizontal surface. The vessel is fully filled with milk.

(i) Find the volume of the milk in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) The circular cone is now held vertically in the vessel as shown in Figure 3(b). A craftsman claims that the volume of the milk remaining in the vessel is greater than \(0.3\text{ m}^3\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
original.stemZh:
12. 圖 3

(a) 顯示一個底半徑為 \(48\) cm、高為 \(96\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓錐。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示該圓錐的體積。

(b) 一個半徑為 \(60\) cm 的半球形容器垂直放置在水平面上，容器完全注滿牛奶。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示容器中牛奶的體積。
(ii) 現將該圓錐垂直放入容器中，如圖 3

(b) 所示。某工匠聲稱容器中餘下的牛奶體積大於 \(0.3\text{ m}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）
original.hint: A solid placed in a full vessel displaces its submerged volume.
original.hintZh: 盛滿容器後放入立體 → 溢出體積等於浸入部分體積。
original.solution: (a) The cone volume is \[V_C=\frac13\pi(48)^2(96)=73728\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) The hemisphere initially contains \(V_H=\frac23\pi(60)^3=144000\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (ii) The cone's base touches the hemispherical wall. In an axial section, the distance from the rim plane to the cone's base is \[d=\sqrt{60^2-48^2}=36\text{ cm}.\] The part above the rim is a smaller cone of height \(96-36=60\) cm, similar to the whole cone. Volumes scale as the cube of corresponding heights. Therefore the submerged frustum displaces \[V_D=73728\pi\left[1-\left(\frac{60}{96}\right)^3\right]=55728\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The milk remaining is \[V_H-V_D=88272\pi\text{ cm}^3=0.088272\pi\text{ m}^3\approx0.277\text{ m}^3.\] Since this is less than \(0.3\text{ m}^3\), the claim is incorrect.

（a）圓錐體積：
\[
V_C=\frac13\pi(48)^2(96)=73728\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）（i）半球初始盛奶：
\[
V_H=\frac23\pi(60)^3=144000\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）（ii）圓錐底面接觸半球壁。軸向切面中，邊緣平面至圓錐底面距離：
\[
d=\sqrt{60^2-48^2}=36\text{ cm}.
\]
邊緣以上部分為高 96−36 = 60 cm 的小圓錐，與整錐相似。體積按高度立方縮放。浸水截頭錐排水量：
\[
V_D=73728\pi\left[1-\left(\frac{60}{96}\right)^3\right]=55728\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
剩餘牛奶：
\[
V_H-V_D=88272\pi\text{ cm}^3\approx0.277\text{ m}^3.
\]
少於 0.3 m³，聲稱不正確。

original.stem:
11.

(a) Figure 2(a) shows a container of height \(8\) cm which is in the shape of a frustum. The container is made by cutting off a right circular cone with a base circumference of \(24\pi\) cm from a hollow circular cone with a base circumference of \(36\pi\) cm. The container is fully filled with water. Find the volume of the water in the container in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A solid sphere is placed inside the container as shown in Figure 2(b). It is known that the radius of the sphere equals to the height of the container.

(i) Find the volume of the sphere.
(ii) Abby claims that the ratio of the volume of the water remaining in the container to the volume of the water which flowed out is greater than \(2:1\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
original.stemZh:
11.

(a) 圖 2

(a) 顯示一個高 \(8\) cm 的截頭錐形容器，由切除一個底圓周 \(24\pi\) cm 的直立圓錐造成，而該圓錐取自一個底圓周 \(36\pi\) cm 的空心圓錐。容器完全注滿水。以 \(\pi\) 求容器中水的體積。

(b) 如圖 2

(b)，將一個實心球放入容器內。已知球的半徑等於容器的高度。

(i) 求球的體積。
(ii) Abby 聲稱容器中餘下的水體積與溢出的水體積之比大於 \(2:1\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
original.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
original.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \( rac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \( rac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
original.solution: (a) Let the upper and lower radii of the frustum be \(r_1\) and \(r_2\) respectively. Since the circumferences are \(24\pi\) cm and \(36\pi\) cm, \[2\pi r_1=24\pi,\qquad 2\pi r_2=36\pi.\] Thus \[r_1=12,\qquad r_2=18.\] Let \(h\) be the height of the original cone. By similarity, \[\frac{h-8}{h}=\frac{12}{18}.\] Hence \[ h=24. \] The volume of water in the container is the volume of the frustum: \[V =\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)-\frac13\pi(12)^2(16)\\ =\boxed{1824\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b)(i) The radius of the sphere is \(8\) cm. \[

\]

\[

\[

(a) Find the base radius of the right circular cone.
(b) A hemispherical bowl of radius 73 cm contains some water originally. The solid right circular cone in (a) is then slowly put into the bowl until it sits vertically in the bowl as shown in the figure below. After placing the cone in the bowl, the water level rises and the bowl is just full of water.

matchedInventory.answer:
14. (a) Volume of the metal sphere
\[\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{4}{3} \pi(36)^{3} \\
& =62208 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}
\end{aligned}\]

Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of the right circular cone.
\[\begin{aligned}
& \frac{1}{3} \pi(81) r^{2}=62208 \pi \\
& r=48
\end{aligned}\]
∴ The base radius of the right circular cone is 48 cm .
(b) Refer to the following figure.

Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the length of \(M N\).
\[\begin{aligned}
73^{2} & =h^{2}+48^{2} \quad \quad \text { (Pyth. theorem) } \\
h & =\sqrt{73^{2}-48^{2}} \\
& =55 \\
V N & =V M-M N \\
& =(81-55) \mathrm{cm} \\
& =26 \mathrm{~cm}
\end{aligned}\]

Total surface area of the sphere and the cylinder
\[\begin{aligned}
& =2 \pi(73)^{2}+\pi(48)^{2}+\pi(48) \sqrt{81^{2}+48^{2}}\left[1-\left(\frac{26}{81}\right)^{2}\right] \\
& =12962 \pi+\pi(48) \sqrt{8865}\left(\frac{5885}{6561}\right) \\
& =53500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}(3 \text { s.f. }) \\
& >5.3 \mathrm{~m}^{2}
\end{aligned}\]
\(\therefore \quad\) The claim is disagreed.
